description: This PHP class 'ModuleListProvider' provides methods to retrieve and process a list of modules, including filtering, labeling, and access control, within the SuiteCRM system.

classes.name: ModuleListProvider
classes.description: Provides module list with filtering, labeling, and access control functionalities.

methods.name: getModuleList
methods.description: Retrieves a list of modules accessible to the current user, applying filtering, visibility, and access rights.

methods.name: addModuleLabels
methods.description: Adds human-readable labels to modules based on language strings.

methods.name: removeInvisibleModules
methods.description: Removes modules from the list that are marked as invisible.

methods.name: markACLAccess
methods.description: Marks modules with access rights based on user permissions.

methods.name: buildAccessArray
methods.description: Builds an array of actions the user has access to for a specific module.

methods.name: hasACL
methods.description: Checks if the current user has administrative privileges or sufficient ACL level for a module.
